|game_text=Plays on table. Substituted battle destinies do not count against battle destiny limits. If all your battle destinies were canceled (and not redrawn) use 1 for your total battle destiny instead. Once per game, may play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Chasm (V)]]; it is the current text. The images are the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VSh-L-chasm-pre.gif]]) and the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1200-7-shield-master.png]]), which print it. The earlier text, shown on the PC website card list until 12 February 2013, is on [[Chasm (V)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Chasm (V)]]): the earliest known text, on the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 12 February 2013)<ref name="cl-1200_7">Players Committee website card list (VShieldsType, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064820/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VShieldsType.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121213024746/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VShieldsType.html 2012-12-13], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130212003929/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VShieldsType.html 2013-02-12]; the same text in the VMasterType list) (Internet Archive)</ref>; the first release sheet that printed this shield has not been found: “Plays on table. Substituted battle destinies do not count against battle destiny limits. If all your battle destinies were canceled (and not redrawn) your total battle destiny = 1. Once per game, may play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 17, marked “E” for errata)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=17, page 17. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=17 Internet Archive]</ref>, the Virtual Shields sheet (21 May 2013, PDF page 5)<ref name="vshields">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf#page=5 Players Committee Virtual Shields sheet] (Defensive Shield pages of the Virtual Cards Master List, PDF made 21 May 2013), PDF page 5, slip 33 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180941/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref> and the Players Committee card image (marked “E”): “Plays on table. Substituted battle destinies do not count against battle destiny limits. If all your battle destinies were canceled (and not redrawn) use 1 for your total battle destiny instead. Once per game, may play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect.” The Players Committee announced this errata on 21 August 2012, effective immediately: the shield no longer “defines” a new total battle destiny but lets you substitute a value of 1<ref name="pcforum-p747235">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post by Aglets, 21 August 2012 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20150320030739/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/forums/viewtopic.php?f=871&t=36574#p747235 Internet Archive copy], captured 20 March 2015)</ref>.
